user.title: Connect to Cellar Circle
user.description: Home Assistant will register itself with Cellar Circle, then send you there to sign in and choose what to allow. Choose **Read only**: this integration only looks.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Cellar Circle again
reauth_confirm.description: Cellar Circle no longer accepts this connection (it was disconnected, or not used for 90 days). Sign in again to keep the sensors updating.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Cellar Circle at that address.
error.api_off: That Cellar Circle does not have its API switched on (MCP_ENABLED).
error.registration_failed: Cellar Circle refused to register Home Assistant. If your Home Assistant address is not https, set up an https external URL or My Home Assistant first.

abort.already_configured: That Cellar Circle is already connected.
